confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listings checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are the most reliable; accommodation is less certain, and hostel dorm and private-room prices are weakest because Ocho Rios has few registered hostels. Accommodation figures assume July low-season rates with Jamaican taxes and mandatory fees included.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Caribbean and Latin American resort towns with similar tourism demand, such as Montego Bay and Negril in Jamaica and Puerto Plata in the Dominican Republic. Drink prices are anchored to the local beer price, which is the typical relationship in Jamaican restaurants and bars.
